name: Quyet Mountain
kicker: Quang Trung’s temple above the Lam
summary: Climb Núi Quyết for the Quang Trung temple and the view over the city and sông Lam. The temple is on the second summit, 92 m above the sea, where the 1 October 1788 edict sited Phượng Hoàng Trung Đô. The city page says that capital was started and not finished. The fee was not printed. The solar dates of the two lunar anniversaries are check on arrival.

body: Climb to the temple and look over the city, sông Lam, and Hồng Lĩnh. The city introduction puts the temple on the second summit, 92 m above the sea. The 1 October 1788 edict sited Phượng Hoàng Trung Đô here. The same page describes that capital as started and not finished. The photograph of the roof is the courtyard. The river is the other frame, from the mountain, not from the temple steps.

The roundup places the temple in phường Trung Đô. Trung Đô is one of the old wards in phường Trường Vinh from 1 July 2025. It says the management board receives more than 110,000 visits a year. The two large days are the death anniversary on the 29th of the 7th lunar month and the Ngọc Hồi–Đống Đa anniversary on the 5th of the 1st lunar month. A second calendar was not opened.

This hill is in the city. Kim Liên is another commune, 15 km on the city portal and 13 km by Quốc lộ 46 on the 2025 news page. Do not send this visit there. A fee was not loaded. Do not import a blog price. Minutes and kilometres from the square were not printed. Check on arrival.
